findings.rule: MDC-026 unknown/paused is not authoritatively empty
findings.mechanism: On initial offline/paused query data is undefined, isPending=true, isLoading=false and fetchStatus=paused. source.status is initial and brief loads, but three section branches test only isLoading. Table mounts the diagnostic with meta undefined and displays No signals cached; cache panel says diagnostics unavailable and category panel says no categorized signals despite no successful response.
findings.repro: Future isolated query-result fixture only: selected positive synthetic vehicle ID, data undefined, error null, isPending true, isLoading/isFetching false, fetchStatus paused. Trace/render the three sections; confirm no successful load occurred but their authoritative empty copy appears. Not executed here.
findings.requestedFix: Use derived initial/blocked state for all section bodies; show paused/pending explanation without starting the key-list empty diagnostic, preserving successful empty and retained states.

findings.mechanism: The independent keys query consumes only data/isError. isError forces otherKeys=[] even with retained keys; loading and fatal error both render no subsection. The main outer banner describes the selected cache, not this failed keys query. Page dataSources registers only redis-signals, so its shared retry does not cover keys.
findings.repro: Future isolated keys-query fixture with populated retained keys plus isError=true while selected cache is successfully empty: existing other-vehicle recovery chips disappear. With data undefined and keys failure, no keys-specific error/retry is rendered. Not executed here.
findings.requestedFix: Existing useRedisSignals.ts should own the keys query; diagnostic should retain previous keys with independent loading/fatal/refresh/paused notices and individual retry.

findings.rule: MDC-026 every data source exposes trust/recovery
findings.mechanism: useSelectedVehicle discards fleet query status/error/refetch and normalizes vehicles undefined to[]. With no URL/stored selection an initial fleet failure produces null selection/empty options indistinguishable from no vehicles; page has no fleet retry or notice.
findings.repro: Future fixture: no URL/persisted vehicle and useVehicles initial error with data undefined. Trace returned null ID/[] and page select prompt with no fleet-specific error/retry. Not executed here.
findings.requestedFix: Expose additive fleet trust/refetch through the existing selector; distinguish initial fleet loading/failure/successful-empty in the local admin control.

findings.mechanism: Signal queryFn takes no QueryFunctionContext and getRedisSignals accepts no options; key query similarly calls getRedisSignalKeys(50) without signal. TanStack cancellation cannot reach request/fetch even though request supports AbortSignal. Vehicle-key separation prevents cross-key row mixing but does not cancel the obsolete request.
findings.repro: Future request-spy fixture: start read then cancel/unmount/change selected vehicle; inspect options and signal.aborted. Current helpers never receive a signal. No request made here.
findings.requestedFix: Forward queryFn {signal} through both existing GET helpers, retaining enablement, keys, polling, stale/retry behavior and mutation semantics.

findings.mechanism: Frontend meta requires l1_last_seen_at/l2_last_seen_at:string|null and vehicle_vin:string. Backend omitempty pointers/string omit these keys when absent; omission is not JSON null. Page guards avoid the current display crash but interface contract is inaccurate.
findings.repro: Future serializer/type fixture with nil last-seen pointers and empty VIN: server JSON lacks these keys; current TS required-field model cannot represent that payload faithfully. No API call here.
findings.requestedFix: Align optional metadata fields with actual Go omitempty tags without fabricating timestamps, VIN or zeros.

findings.rule: MDC-026/MDC-033 unknown is not measured zero
findings.mechanism: RawFieldCount returns0+error when HLEN fails; handler discards that error and emits0. Optional nil signalStore also leaves l1Count at0. These best-effort unknowns become valid KPI/count values and may trigger L2 mirror failing diagnosis when L1 has data.
findings.repro: Future fake-repository/cache handler fixture: GetAll succeeds, RawFieldCount fails, L1 contains one value; result reports raw L2 count0 and diagnostic selects mirror failure. Separate nil-L1 fixture reports measured0 despite unavailable store. No real Redis operation here.
findings.requestedFix: Backend owner exposes diagnostic availability/unknowns explicitly; existing typed adapter and diagnostic must not treat fallback0 as authoritative emptiness.

findings.mechanism: Typed Redis decoder returns int32, int64 and float32 for their canonical kinds. Handler recognizes only float64 as number and bool as boolean, so those valid numeric Go values are tagged string while JSON value remains numeric. Numeric/string KPI counts and type filtering become incorrect.
findings.repro: Future fake GetAll map with an int64(7) or float32(1.5): handler emits numeric JSON value with type string; redisMetrics places it in Strings, not Numbers. Source switch establishes mechanism; not executed here.
findings.requestedFix: Classify all supported canonical numeric kinds correctly at existing handler/model boundary and cover the exact discriminator cases.

findings.rule: Raw-value preservation and JSON/null type agreement
findings.mechanism: Decoder supports compound/generic JSON and legacy JSON objects/arrays; generic JSON null is possible. Handler Value interface{} emits these unchanged but tags them string. Frontend RedisSignalEntry excludes objects/arrays/null and String(row.value) turns objects into [object Object], arrays into ambiguous comma lists and null into literal null. Operator cannot inspect full structured cache value in the cell.
findings.repro: Future synthetic JSON fixture only: signals.ExampleComposite={value:{example:1},type:'string'} or nested array/null. Trace current String conversion and incompatible entry type; object contents disappear from cell. No real signal contents used.
findings.requestedFix: Precisely type the actual supported JSON values/discriminator and render structured raw content with existing Code/Text primitives and explicit null/unknown semantics; preserve exports, source identity and masking policy.

findings.rule: MDC-020/MDC-040 native navigation and nonnested interaction
findings.mechanism: Docs CTA places shared Button, which always emits button, inside an anchor. The resulting a>button has nested interactive elements and competing link/button semantics. No browser-specific keyboard consequence is claimed.
findings.repro: Future component render of a diagnostic branch with CTA; inspect resulting a>button structure and link/button accessibility tree. Source expansion confirms invalid nesting; runtime untested.
findings.requestedFix: Use one real anchor/navigation element with existing shared link-button styling; preserve href, target, rel, localized CTA, focus and hit target.

findings.rule: MDC-044 localized fallback and numeric display
findings.mechanism: Other-cache fallback literally renders Vehicle ${id}; diagnostic metadata/chip counts render raw numbers. Category option suffix concatenates raw count instead of locale formatter/interpolation. Existing redis.vehicleFallback and fmtInt are already available elsewhere.
findings.repro: Future non-English locale fixture with absent display_name/VIN and large counts: fallback remains English and diagnostic/category counts bypass locale digits/grouping. No catalog changes or runtime locale test here.
findings.requestedFix: Reuse existing translated fallback and number formatting, preserving raw identifier semantics; parent catalog owner handles any required interpolation key.

findings.rule: Stale-versus-unknown per-value evidence without erasing raw cache data
findings.mechanism: Pass-through GetAll preserves stale/legacy values. Timestamp-aware GetAllValues is reduced to only maximum timestamp; no row timestamp/provenance is serialized. Fresh HTTP fetch of a mixed cache therefore cannot distinguish a stale row from a timestamp-less legacy row. A recent unrelated row can make l2_last_seen_at recent; decode/read failures and entirely legacy cache both yield missing L2 timestamp. Fetch-age chip is not evidence of datum age.
findings.repro: Future fake timestamp-aware cache fixture with one recent envelope, one envelope older than2min and one zero-timestamp legacy entry. Current response contains all raw values but only newest timestamp, so the last two cannot be separately classified. Repeat with GetAllValues error to show unknown vs error collapse. Not executed here.
findings.requestedFix: Existing integration owner exposes per-value observed timestamp/provenance/read-availability, or explicitly presents freshness as unknown where contract cannot supply it. Preserve every stale/legacy raw value; do not turn the diagnostic endpoint into a fresh-only filter.
